context.body: A Gospel genealogy places Noah within Jesus’ human ancestry and the wider line to Adam.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Luke’s genealogy moves backward from Jesus through David and Abraham to Noah, Lamech, Adam, and God.
observations.label: Luke places Noah in Jesus’ ancestry: action

observations.body: Noah is one link in a lineage with a direction and endpoint different from Chronicles.
observations.label: Luke places Noah in Jesus’ ancestry: response

payload.posture: Read Luke 3:23–38 as warning, faith, and water evidence before carrying it into another source.
